decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree that LH-02 (E569-07) and LH-03 (C564-03) are down with hydraulic faults. Repairs are likely 4 to 5 h (range 3 to 6 h), so I don't count on either loader coming back soon. No confirmation is needed under CONFIRM-01. Nothing is activated from reserve, because RESERVE-01 needs a loader freed from a stopped stope and both broken loaders are immobile. LH-10 is idle at TALLER-564, so lending it costs nothing. It goes to C564-03: about 0.3 h travel, then roughly 6.7 h at about 31 t/h, or about 207 t of the 241 t left. At 9.6 g/t that is about 64 oz. Central's stockpile is at 228 of 450 t, so it has room. LH-08 goes to E569-07. It is a development heading (value 1.3 oz/h), so the loss is about 1.3 × 6.5 h ≈ 8.5 oz. Travel is about 0.55 h, then about 27 t/h. That clears the remaining 164 t at 10.5 g/t, about 55 oz. Este's stockpile is nearly empty (48 of 450 t), so there is no cap issue. Net for LH-08 is about +46 oz. I did not lend LH-09: it is the critical-path heading and costs 4.2 oz/h, about 27 oz, which is more than any extra gain. I did not take loaders from producing stopes. Total is about 64 + 46 = 110 oz, which I round down to 100 oz for the truck and repair uncertainty.
